IBM 的小型多語向量模型，以 ModernBERT 架構、剪枝與蒸餾縮小模型，: A compact multilingual embedding model from IBM. It uses ModernBERT, pruning and distillation to produce 384-dimensional vectors.
EMBEDDER · 270M 文字部分（約 2.7 億；完整多模態 740M）: EMBEDDER · 270M text parameters (740M full multimodal model)
Google 的小型多語向量模型。本次只使用文字部分，將問題與文件轉成同一空間的: A compact multilingual embedding model from Google. This benchmark uses only the text component to map queries and documents into a shared 768-dimensional space.
支援多語的向量模型；原始模型還能提供關鍵字權重與多向量檢索。本次使用單一向量的: A multilingual embedding model that also supports sparse weights and multi-vector retrieval. This benchmark uses only its single-vector dense retrieval mode.
CodeFuse 的多語指令向量模型，使用 Qwen3 架構；系列訓練特別重視中: An instruction-based multilingual embedding model from CodeFuse, built on Qwen3. Its training emphasizes medium- and low-resource languages.
Qwen 系列較小的多語向量模型，將問題與文件轉成向量，適合先找出一批可能相關的: A smaller multilingual embedder in the Qwen family. It maps queries and documents into vectors to retrieve a set of potentially relevant passages.
Qwen 系列中型多語向量模型，用較大的模型與向量表示問題和文件，可獨立搜尋或搭: A mid-sized multilingual Qwen embedder with larger model and vector representations. It can search on its own or feed a reranker.
本次受測 Qwen 向量模型中最大的一款，以 4096 維表示文字，適合先評估獨: The largest Qwen embedder in this benchmark. It represents text with 4,096-dimensional vectors and is worth evaluating when standalone retrieval quality matters.
先由向量模型找出候選段落，再逐對閱讀問題與段落，重新排出相關順序的多語模型。: A multilingual model that scores each query–passage pair after initial vector retrieval and reorders the candidates by relevance.
Qwen 系列較小的多語重排器，在候選段落已找出後，再判斷哪些內容更能回答問題。: The smaller multilingual Qwen reranker evaluates which retrieved candidates are more relevant to the query.
較大型的多語重排器，適合願意增加等待時間、希望提高候選文件排序品質的情境。: A larger multilingual reranker for workflows that can tolerate more latency to improve candidate ordering.
不需任務提示，使用流程直接；本次可在較短查詢時間下取得具競爭力的結果。: No task prefix is required, making the input format straightforward. It delivers competitive results with short query latency in this run.
本次沒有測 sparse、ColBERT 多向量或混合檢索，不能用這張成績單代表: Sparse retrieval, ColBERT-style multi-vector retrieval and hybrid search were not tested. These results do not represent every BGE-M3 capability.

只能重排前一階段找來的文件，無法補回候選清單外的答案；分數不是答案正確機率。: It can only reorder retrieved candidates, not recover answers outside the candidate set. Its score is not the probability that an answer is correct.

文字部分僅 270M 參數；官方支援縮減向量維度及選擇性載入多模態元件，便於按需: The text component has only 270M parameters. Official support for reduced vector dimensions and selectively loaded multimodal components allows deployments to fit different needs.
本次未測圖像、音訊、影片或縮減維度。官方 HF 推論建議 BF16／FP32、避: Images, audio, video and reduced vector dimensions were not tested. 本次獨立檢索的三方向平均 Top-1 在小型受測模型中具有競爭力；官方也提供訓練: Competitive average standalone Top-1 across the three directions among the smaller tested models. The project also publishes training data and code.
本次只測獨立檢索，沒有搭配任何重排器；不能把尚未測試的組合列為實測推薦。使用的是: Only standalone retrieval was tested, with no reranker pairings. Untested pairs cannot be presented as measured recommendations. This run used a community-converted Q8_0 GGUF.
本輪只測 standalone，沒有搭配 reranker 的結果；不能宣稱尚未: Only standalone retrieval was tested for this model. There are no reranker results, so untested pairs cannot be claimed to be the most effective.
本次模型尺寸最小、平均查詢時間最短；適合把計算成本與等待時間放在前面評估的使用者: The smallest weight file and shortest mean query time in this run. Consider it when compute cost and response time take priority.
本次 Top-1 較低，省資源需接受品質取捨；只有獨立檢索結果，未測重排組合。9: Lower Top-1 in this run means a quality trade-off for the resource savings. Reranker pairings were not tested. Do not assume that the 97M model supports the MRL features of the 311M version.
支援任務提示與向量維度縮減；可把重排交給另一個模型，依用途調整品質與計算成本。: Supports task instructions and reduced embedding dimensions. A separate reranker lets you tune the balance between quality and compute.
本次只測 Q8_0、1024 維與固定英文檢索提示；未測縮減維度。單用模型與搭配: Only Q8_0, 1,024 dimensions and a fixed English retrieval instruction were tested. Reduced dimensions were not evaluated. Compare standalone and reranked results separately.
本次提供比 0.6B 更高的獨立檢索 Top-1；搭配相同 Qwen 4B 重排: Higher standalone Top-1 than the 0.6B embedder in this run. With the same Qwen 4B reranker, its average Top-1 across directions matches the 8B embedder.
平均相同不代表每題結果或所有資料庫表現相同；本測候選庫較小，不能推論大規模知識庫: Equal averages do not imply identical per-query results or behavior on every corpus. The test corpora are small, so the same gaps should not be assumed for large knowledge bases.
本次獨立檢索三方向平均 Top-1 最高，中文查中文與中文查英文方向亦表現突出。: The highest average standalone Top-1 across the three directions, with strong Chinese-to-Chinese and Chinese-to-English results.
模型大不保證每個方向都第一；本次英文查英文低於 4B 一題。搭配重排後的收益需連: A larger model does not win every direction: it trails 4B by one task on English-to-English retrieval here. Weigh reranking gains against latency and weight size.
本次整體 Top-1 高於 BGE 重排；相對 4B 重排器，等待時間較短。: Higher overall Top-1 than BGE reranking in this run, with lower latency than the 4B reranker.
跨語方向未必優於 BGE；需要正確模板與 yes/no 分類實作。本次每次重排: It does not always beat BGE on cross-language retrieval. Correct templates and yes/no scoring are required. Each request reranks 50 documents here; changing the candidate count affects quality and time.
本次整體 Top-1 最高；相對 0.6B 重排器，中文查英文的平均提升比英文查: The highest overall Top-1 in this run. Compared with the 0.6B reranker, the gain is larger for Chinese-to-English than English-to-English retrieval.
本次每 50 篇平均重排約需數秒；這是 Apple M3 Ultra 的測量，不: Reranking 50 documents takes several seconds on average on the tested Apple M3 Ultra. This does not guarantee performance on other hardware, and relevant documents outside the candidate set still cannot be recovered.

數字怎麼來，能解釋到哪裡。: Where the numbers come from, and what they mean.
首頁保留選型重點；這裡整理評測條件、品質指標、可信範圍與可重現的證據。: The homepage focuses on model selection. This page explains test conditions, metrics, limits and reproducible evidence.
Embedder 把文字轉成向量，拿來找出相近文章；reranker 對問題與候: An embedder turns text into vectors to retrieve similar passages. A reranker scores queries together with candidate passages to reorder them. We evaluate the rank of relevant documents, not generated answers or translation quality.
方向代碼先寫 corpus 語言，再寫 query 語言。因此 eng-zho: Configuration codes name the corpus language first and query language second. Thus eng-zho means Chinese-to-English retrieval. English-to-Chinese was not tested.
7 款 embedder 各自 standalone；其中 Qwen 0.6B／: Seven embedders are tested standalone. Qwen 0.6B/4B/8B, BGE-M3 and EmbeddingGemma 2 are each paired with three rerankers: 22 configurations in total. Across three directions, this gives 66 groups of 100 queries, or 6,600 measurements. F2LLM and Granite have no reranker pairings.
同一批 300 個方向／問題任務在多組模型上重複測試，不能把 6,600 筆當成: The same 300 direction/query tasks are repeated across model configurations; 6,600 measurements are not 6,600 independent questions. Each direction uses 100 queries selected by SHA-256 with seed 20261022. The full validation corpus is retained, with official qrels defining relevant documents.
每次先做 L2 正規化與 exact cosine 搜尋，取前 50 篇交給 r: Vectors are L2-normalized and searched using exact cosine similarity. The first 50 candidates go to the reranker. BGE-M3 is tested in dense mode only, without sparse or multi-vector hybrid retrieval. All models use Q8_0; quantization precision is not compared.
第一篇就是標註相關文章的比例；首頁主要指標。: The share of tasks with a relevant document ranked first; the main homepage metric.
相關文章越早出現在前十名，分數越高；第一名得1，第二名得1/2。: Rewards relevant documents appearing earlier in the first 10 results: rank 1 scores 1, rank 2 scores 1/2.
綜合前十名相關文章的位置，越靠前越好；本次使用二元 qrels。: Measures the positions of relevant documents in the top 10, rewarding earlier ranks. This benchmark uses binary qrels.
已標註相關文章中，有多少進入前10／50名。: The fraction of labeled relevant documents retrieved within the first 10 or 50 results.
平均是算術平均；p50 是中位數；p95 是95%測量不超過的值。所有彙總 p9: Mean is the arithmetic average; p50 is the median; p95 is the value that 95% of measurements do not exceed. Aggregate p95 values are recomputed from individual measurements, not averaged across groups.
「失敗」表示沒有把 qrels 標註文件排在指定位置；qrels 未必涵蓋所有可: A failure means a qrels-labeled document was not placed in the evaluated position. Qrels may omit other passages that answer the query. Similar content, missing query context and unlabeled relevant passages require human review.

warmed query 分階段計時；總時間為 embedding、exact: Warmed queries timed by stage; total time is the sum of embedding, exact search and reranking
不含建索引、模型載入、production router、網路、佇列與併發。權重: Timings exclude index building, model loading, production routing, network overhead, queues and concurrency. Weight sizes come directly from GGUF file bytes. Adding two file sizes is not a peak RAM/VRAM measurement. No other hardware was benchmarked.
只採用 2026-10-22 22:23:41 完成的 run-20261022: Only run-20261022-v3-guarded, completed at 2026-10-22 22:23:41 Taipei time, is included. Rankings do not mix v1, v2, September runs or other candidate counts. External traffic invalidated one unfinished attempt; that entire group was rerun before acceptance.
本次發佈前重新比對 66 組摘要、6,600 唯一列、66 accepted a: Before publication, we checked 66 group summaries, 6,600 unique records and 66 accepted attempts. We independently recomputed quality metrics from 2,100 embedding-cache rankings and 4,500 reranker final_ids records, finding no inconsistencies. Original audit records also verified complete GPU offload for accepted attempts. Preparing the website did not rerun model inference.
每方向 100 題，一題就是 1 個百分點；三方向平均的一題約為 0.33 個百: With 100 queries per direction, one task is one percentage point. One task in the three-direction average is about 0.33 pp. BGE-M3 and F2LLM standalone differ by just one task; prioritize testing your own workload.
原研究提供 45 組「reranker 相對同 embedder standal: The original study reports 45 paired-bootstrap intervals comparing rerankers with the same standalone embedder: 2,000 resamples, fixed seed, n=100 per group. These intervals are exploratory, without multiple-comparison correction. They do not directly establish a significant difference between the 4B and 0.6B rerankers.
資料庫只有 430–978 篇、每方向 100 題，候選 Recall@50 接: The corpora contain only 430–978 documents, with 100 queries per direction and near-ceiling candidate Recall@50. Results should not be extrapolated directly to long documents, million-document knowledge bases, specialized domains, different quantization or other hardware.
與公開已知內容相比，本次補上什麼？: What does this add to published knowledge?
已介紹多語檢索、任務提示及不同模型尺寸。: describes multilingual retrieval, task instructions and different model sizes.
在固定 GGUF／Metal 與同一批問題上，量到不同尺寸的方向品質與時間。這不: This run measures direction-specific quality and latency across sizes on fixed GGUF/Metal settings and queries. It does not claim to discover cross-language retrieval.
已說明召回後再重排的用途。: describes retrieving candidates before reranking them.
Qwen 4B reranker 相對0.6B，中查英平均增加10.2百分點，英: Upgrading Qwen reranking from 0.6B to 4B adds 10.2 pp on average for Chinese-to-English, but only 0.4 pp for English-to-English. The extra compute has different returns by direction.
呈現模型規模與檢索／重排能力。: reports model scale and retrieval/reranking capabilities.
五款主要 embedder 搭配Qwen4B重排器，都為281/300。Qwen: All five core embedders with the Qwen 4B reranker score 281/300. The Qwen 0.6B and 8B pairings swap success/failure on two tasks, and their full top-50 rankings differ. Equal totals do not make the models equivalent.
均定位小型／高效率 embedding。: both position their models as compact or efficient embedding options.
